name: CRA Submit documents online
notes: Sign in to your CRA account; enter the case or reference number from the letter if CRA asked for the documents.

name: Find a biometrics collection point and book an appointment
notes: Book an appointment as soon as you get the letter. Bring the biometric instruction letter and a valid passport (IRCC: how to give your biometrics).

name: CRA: file an objection (My Account → Register my formal dispute, or form T400A)
notes: P148: file through My Account (Register my formal dispute), by mail or fax with form T400A, or with a signed letter.
